title: The skyscraper/office tower above a mall that resembles the old WTC
content: Not always, but a lot of the time the mall in my dream is underground and connected to a huge skyscraper and a major train hub. It's always hard to get out of the mall and into the skyscraper, but if I do it's always full of weird elevators everywhere that don't make sense and a labyrinth of offices that are mostly vacant. The whole thing has very similar vibes to the old WTC and the stores that used to be underneath, except there's only one tower. Anyone else ever experience similar? I'm sure growing up near NYC has had an aesthetic influence, though I never visited the old WTC mall.
